'''Canyon Oasis''' was a location somewhere in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It existed during the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]],<ref name="DF2" /> during the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]].<ref name="TNEC" /> The oasis, located in a canyon, contained large platforms, an expansive pool, a system of underground tunnels, and a ramp that could become electrified with the push of a button. The oasis was a battle arena, and was heavily stocked with weapons, ammunition, [[Personal energy shield/Legends|personal energy shields]], and [[Bio-Bacta]] canisters. The various weapons stocked in the arena included [[rail detonator]]s, [[Imperial repeater rifle|Imperial Repeater Rifle]]s, [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|E-11 blaster rifles]], a [[Stouker concussion rifle]], and [[sequencer charge]]s.<ref name="DF2" />

==Behind the scenes==
Canyon Oasis first appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]'' as a multiplayer level for deathmatch, referred to in game as Jedi Training, a game mode where players fought against other players by themselves. Although the map's precise location is unclear, the textures used in the map are also used in singleplayer levels depicting the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]]. The multiplayer mode could allow up to eight players to compete.<ref name="DF2" />
